cityForm.moveRules: Moving needs every army of this city at home and no foreign troops on the way. Occupied valleys are released.

cityForm.teleportPrice: {{item}} · {{price}} gold: a free flat tile you choose
cityForm.keepsName: {{name}} is a historic city and keeps its name: it can't be renamed.

taxRate.label: Tax rate
taxRate.description: This share of each hour's new food, lumber, stone and iron is sold to the merchant as it is produced. Stored resources are never sold. The base tax ({{baseTax}} gold) is paid at any rate.
taxRate.descriptionFixed: This share of each hour's new food, lumber, stone and iron is sold to the merchant at {{price}} gold each as it is produced. Stored resources are never sold. The base tax ({{baseTax}} gold) is paid at any rate.
taxRate.previewFor: At {{rate}}%: {{sold}} gold from sold output for {{list}}.

workRates.label: Production work rates
workRates.description: Lower a rate to free that field type's workers: they become idle population you can train troops from. At 0% the fields produce nothing. Idle now: {{idle}} · In the fields: {{workers}}.

abandon.warning: Abandoning a city can't be undone. After {{time}} all of it is lost for good: its heroes, troops, resources and buildings, its armies wherever they are, research running there, its market orders and shipments. Nothing moves to another city and nothing is refunded. Its valleys are released.
abandon.keepRegular: You must keep at least one regular city, as a historic city can be captured, so this one can't be abandoned.
abandon.confirmDescription: In {{time}} this city is gone for good, with everything listed here. Nothing moves to another city and nothing is refunded.
abandon.road: Move out anything you want to keep before you start: an army sent away during that time and still on the road when it ends is lost too.
abandon.typeName: Type the city's name, {{city}}, to confirm
